claims.claim: Mia Torres and Kofi Mensah ran the technical validation demo for Hugo Brandt, Juniper's IT Manager.
claims.why: Transcript shows Mia, Kofi, and Hugo on the call; CRM gives Hugo's title and stage.

claims.claim: The demo was scheduled 16:00-16:06 on 2026-09-29.
claims.why: CRM demo fields give scheduled start 16:00 and end 16:06 on 2026-09-29.

claims.claim: Hugo was the only customer attendee.
claims.why: Mia asked if anyone else was coming and Hugo said no, just him.

claims.claim: Kofi showed the meter readings file Hugo's team sent, loaded and partitioned by region.
claims.why: U004 describes the meter readings file loaded and partitioned by region.

claims.claim: The meter file load took about 4 minutes.
claims.why: Kofi said it took about 4 minutes.

claims.claim: Kofi showed a daily usage view by region.
claims.why: U006 states the daily usage view by region.

claims.claim: Hugo's responses were brief and neutral ("Okay," "Fine," "Sure").
claims.why: Hugo said Okay, Fine, and Sure.

claims.claim: Hugo gave no feedback on fit and raised no questions.
claims.why: Hugo never answered fit directly or asked questions.

claims.claim: When asked if the demo was close to what his team wants, Hugo said he isn't the decision-maker and only sets up access.
claims.why: U009 says he is not the one who decides and just sets up access.

claims.claim: Hugo thought the decision-maker is probably operations but didn't know who.
claims.why: Hugo said 'Probably operations. I'm not sure who.'

claims.claim: Kofi offered to send the load summary and Hugo agreed.
claims.why: Kofi said he'd send the load summary; Hugo said Sure.

claims.claim: The transcript has no content between 00:20 and 03:30 or between 03:34 and 05:12.
claims.why: Timestamps jump between those lines; the output flags it as unclear whether silence or uncaptured.

claims.claim: The call produced no confirmation that the demo meets Juniper's requirements.
claims.why: No customer line confirms fit; Hugo deflected the fit question.

claims.claim: Hugo's silence on fit shouldn't be read as approval.
claims.why: Hugo did not answer the fit question, so approval isn't established.

claims.claim: The CRM lists the pain 'Meter data loads are manual'.
claims.why: CRM discovery pains contains that exact entry.

claims.claim: The call didn't tie the demo to the manual load pain or a business outcome.
claims.why: No line mentions manual loads or any outcome.

claims.claim: No champion or economic buyer is recorded in the CRM, and Hugo is the only contact.
claims.why: CRM champion and economic_buyer are empty; contacts list only Hugo.

claims.claim: The decision process is unknown; CRM says 'Not discussed' and this call didn't change that.
claims.why: CRM says Not discussed; call only gave 'probably operations'.

claims.claim: Nothing was scheduled; no dated next step was agreed on the call.
claims.why: No follow-up meeting appears; CRM dated_next_step is blank.

claims.claim: The CRM fields for dated next step, stakeholder to add, business outcome, and SC commitment are all blank.
claims.why: CRM close_the_demo shows empty values for all four.

claims.claim: The 9/14 discovery note says only 'Agreed the TV items,' without listing them.
claims.why: CRM prior_call_notes 9/14 summary reads exactly that.

claims.claim: The deal is $120K ACV in Technical Validation, entered 2026-09-14, with a close date of 2026-12-18.
claims.why: CRM shows acv 120000, stage TV, tv_entered_at 2026-09-14, close 2026-12-18.

claims.claim: Without access to the decision-maker, the 12/18 close date looks at risk.
claims.why: Follows from no known decision-maker and unlisted close date; a reasonable inference.

claims.claim: Hugo's phone number is missing from the CRM.
claims.why: CRM contact phone is empty.

claims.claim: No competitors are recorded, so competitive position is unknown.
claims.why: CRM competitors list is empty and none were mentioned.

claims.claim: Kofi will send the load summary, with no date stated on the call.
claims.why: Kofi committed without a date; the output says not stated and suggests same day.

claims.claim: Hugo and Mia made no commitments on the call.
claims.why: Hugo only said Sure to receiving the summary; Mia made no commitment.

claims.claim: Kofi sends the load summary and Mia sends the follow-up email today.
claims.why: Kofi said he'd send it with no date; 'today' and Mia's email were not stated.

claims.claim: Ask Hugo for the operations stakeholder's name or an intro, or who requested the evaluation or owns the load process.
claims.why: Proposed action grounded in Hugo saying operations decides but he doesn't know who.

claims.claim: Pull the agreed TV items from the 9/14 discovery call and check which this demo covered.
claims.why: CRM notes 'Agreed the TV items' without listing them; the action follows.

claims.claim: The load summary attached in the email is for the meter readings file Hugo sent.
claims.why: Kofi offered the load summary of the file loaded in the demo.

claims.claim: The email says the file loaded and partitioned by region in about 4 minutes and a daily usage view by region was shown.
claims.why: Matches Kofi's statements.

claims.claim: The email states Hugo mentioned operations is likely involved in the decision.
claims.why: Hugo said 'Probably operations,' so 'likely' fits.

claims.claim: The email proposes a 30-minute follow-up with Hugo and his operations contact.
claims.why: A proposal only, with bracketed placeholder times; not asserted as agreed.
